description: This file defines a Smarty template plugin function 'search_controller' that generates a hidden input element with a search controller value obtained from the SearchWrapper class. It facilitates embedding the current search controller as a hidden form input within templates.

classes.name: SearchWrapper
classes.description: A class that provides search-related functionalities, including retrieving the current search controller.

methods.name: getController
methods.description: Static method that returns the current search controller name or identifier.
